brief.zh: 不用假设框，证出<level-ref to="chain"></level-ref>的「下雨 → 路滑」。
brief.en: Without the assumption box, prove the “it rains → the road is slippery” of <level-ref to="chain"></level-ref>.

hint.zh: 框里的第二次套用是在条件「下雨」下做的：这正是 S 的事。S 的三句选「下雨」「地湿」「路滑」。
hint.en: The box’s second Apply happens under the condition “it rains”: that is S’s job. Choose “it rains”, “the ground is wet”, “the road is slippery” on S.

hint.zh: S 要「下雨 → (地湿 → 路滑)」：用 K 给「地湿 → 路滑」加上条件「下雨」。
hint.en: S wants “it rains → (the ground is wet → the road is slippery)”: let K put the condition “it rains” on “the ground is wet → the road is slippery”.

t.zh: <level-ref to="chain"></level-ref>里，框假设「下雨」，框里做了两次套用。把框拿掉，每一步都要改写：框里用到的已知，用 K 带上条件「下雨」；框里的套用，在条件下做，用 S。
t.en: In <level-ref to="chain"></level-ref> the box assumed “it rains” and did two Applies inside. Take the box away and each step is rewritten: a given used inside gets the condition “it rains” from K; an Apply inside happens under the condition, with S.

after.zh: 这个改写有固定的做法，任何一个框都能这样换成 K、S 和套用（演绎定理）。所以框不增加能证的东西，只是让证明好写得多：这就是证明器把框放进地基、把 K 和 S 降成元件的原因。
after.en: The rewrite follows a fixed recipe, and any box can be traded for K, S and Apply this way (the deduction theorem). So the box adds nothing provable; it only makes proofs far easier to write. That is why the prover puts the box in its foundation and K and S among its parts.
